name: Mail For You, Miss Spider!
source:
Dagmar is a young woman with a very important, borderline sacred job: mail delivery! Sure, some have called her dedication 'overly excessive' and 'borderline disturbing' before, but as far as she's concerned, some jobs need to get done. So when she finds a strange package with a set of coordinates to somewhere remote in place of any proper address... it only makes sense for her to take it to where it needs to go.

Millicent is a young woman with a job she hates... meat processing. She lives alone, reclusive and burdened with a past full of mistakes and hardship. She has a dark secret that she needs to keep hidden more than anything. So when a mailwoman arrives at her doorstep looking for her to sign for a package... she finds herself dealing with a challenge she is not prepared for.

Also, Dagmar is a fly, and Millicent is a spider.

[From [url=https://prismaticvoid.itch.io/mail-for-you-miss-spider]itch.io[/url]]

Set in the same world as BugByteGaming's [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/life-cycles]Life Cycles[/url] and [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/bug-bites-chapter-1]Bug Bites[/url]
translation:
达格玛是一位年轻女子，她从事着一项非常重要、近乎神圣的工作：邮件递送！当然，有些人之前称她的奉献精神“过于过度”和“令人不安”，但就她而言，有些工作需要完成。因此，当她发现一个奇怪的包裹，其中包含一组指向远程某个地方的坐标而不是任何正确的地址时……对她来说，将其带到需要去的地方才有意义。

米利森特是一位年轻女性，从事着她讨厌的工作……肉类加工。她独自生活，与世隔绝，背负着充满错误和艰辛的过去。她有一个最需要隐藏的黑暗秘密。因此，当一名邮递员来到她家门口找她签收包裹时……她发现自己面临着一个她没有准备好的挑战。

另外，达格玛是一只苍蝇，米利森特是一只蜘蛛。

[来自[url=https://prismaticvoid.itch.io/mail-for-you-miss-spider]itch.io[/url]]

与BugByteGaming的 [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/life-cycles]Life Cycles[/url] 和 [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/bug-bites-chapter-1]Bug Bites[/url] 设置在同一个世界中
